# Molecular genetic report

SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE. Not a real patient. Contains planted errors for skill testing.

Report date: 2026-03-02
Patient: Test patient 01 (pseudonym), female, year of birth 1984
Ordering physician: outpatient gynaecology clinic
Sample: EDTA blood, received 2026-02-10
Indication: Breast cancer diagnosed at age 41. Mother with ovarian cancer at age 52. Hereditary breast and ovarian cancer panel requested.

## Method

Targeted NGS panel (BRCA1, BRCA2, PALB2, CHEK2, ATM, RAD51C, RAD51D), reference genome GRCh38, MANE Select transcripts. Coverage at least 20x for 100% of coding regions and 10 bp of flanking intron.

## Result

BRCA1 NM_007294.4:c.5266dup p.(Gln1756Glyfs*12), heterozygous.
Classification: pathogenic (class 5).

## Interpretation

The variant c.5266dup is a frameshift variant predicted to cause nonsense-mediated mRNA decay (PVS1).
It has been reported in many families with hereditary breast and ovarian cancer, including a functional study demonstrating loss of BRCA1 function (PMID: 26931183).
Pathogenic BRCA1 variants cause hereditary breast and ovarian cancer syndrome, which is inherited in an autosomal recessive manner.

## Recommendations

Genetic counselling is recommended.
We recommend that he discuss intensified breast cancer surveillance with his gynaecologist.
Each child of the patient has a 25% risk of inheriting the variant.
Predictive testing can be offered to adult relatives.

## Limitations

This test detects all clinically relevant variants in the genes analysed.
